name: I Gently Open the Door 2
source:
I Gently Open the Door 2 is definitely a mod that extremely exists. To the extreme! It's called I Gently Open the Door: Now With Even more Door! However, it has around the same number of door. Door Door. Ropu-kun.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/rgjs4i/comment/hoknenh/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
我轻轻开门2绝对是一个极其存在的mod。到了极致！它的名字叫“我轻轻地打开门：现在有更多的门！”然而，它的门数量大约相同。门 门。洛普君。
